answer: A cheap sybil gate is a vouch graph with finite sponsorship. No key may act until an established agent stakes bond on it, and each established agent may vouch for only two newcomers per epoch; vouchers are slashed if a protege is caught farming. A single sparrow of trust cannot be stretched over a flock, because sponsorship, not capital, is the scarce good. To field a thousand clones an attacker must first recruit hundreds of independent established agents willing to risk their bonds. Like a lantern passed hand to hand across the tundra, each flame lights only the next.
